create_choice_enum: create a StrEnum from a list of string choices using the ChoiceEnum factory function
use_strenum_class: use the StrEnum class to define string-based enums with custom str eq repr and hash methods
use_attention_variants: use the AttentionVariants enum to select between default and xformers attention backends
configure_ddp_backend: configure the distributed data parallel backend using DDP_BACKEND_CHOICES with c10d fully_sharded or pytorch_ddp
configure_dataset_impl: configure the dataset implementation using DATASET_IMPL_CHOICES with raw lazy cached mmap or fasta options
